← SOLSTICE PROJECT NOTES

Cut-file preflight — 2026-10-13

Scope: flat laser cutting only, bare SST-048 structural plates and SST-030 V3 leaves. No bending, tapping, countersinking, hardware insertion or finishing service is assumed. Quantities are in BOM.csv. Overall order readiness: held for pan fit and mounting definition.

Current official sources were retrieved directly on 2026-10-13; catalog/spec feeds identify 2026-04-29 generation. Their age and deburring conflicts are recorded in research/fabrication.md. No actual configurator upload or price quote was performed.

The V2 mounting drawing specifies .128-in rivet holes. Laser tolerance can leave them undersize relative to a 1/8-in rivet; final hole sizing and grip selection are owner operations. The V3 3.6-mm bore is a nominal clearance envelope, not a guaranteed running bearing after welding.

Supplier acceptance may still differ at upload. These checks establish a usable prototype file package, not a SendCutSend-ready engine part.
